fact: The Government of Mauritius hosted the SADC Capacity Building Workshop on Cyber Security and the first SADC Regional Cyber Drill at Ebene on 10-13 September 2018, attended by delegates from fourteen SADC member states, with the SADC ICT Implementing Agency and CRASA.

The Mauritius Cabinet record of 14 August 2026 states that Mauritius has been a member of SADC since 1995 and that the Prime Minister will attend the 46th SADC Summit in South Africa on 17 August 2026; the document does not mention digital policy.
